summary: Full e2e verification of member profile + Family Address Book (Directory) feature. Backend pytest suite (10/10 passing) covers directory auth requirement, sort order, returned fields; profile PATCH persistence via /auth/me; profile photo upload (accepts png/jpg/gif/webp, rejects text), serve via GET /api/files/{id}, remove, and auth requirement. Frontend Playwright e2e (Victoria + admin) covers Dashboard quicklink, Account 'Your Profile' section edit+save+reload persistence, photo upload/remove flow, Directory listing (3 cards, alphabetical), search filter, no-results state, mailto/tel buttons on cards, and disabled Call state for members without phones. Admin (thetruth219) also sees the directory.
critical_code_review_comments: Directory endpoint returns ALL active members including admins (thetruth219). This matches the product decision ('visible to ALL signed-in family members') but confirm admin accounts should appear as directory entries.
profile.birthday accepts a free-form string (e.g. 'March 14' or ISO). No server-side validation; fine per spec but the display shows the raw value in the directory card.

photo upload validates only file extension, not content_type or actual image bytes. A malicious file named .png with non-image content would still be stored. Consider content-sniffing (e.g., PIL open) for hardening.
GET /api/directory returns up to 1000 members with no pagination — acceptable for a family portal but worth noting for scale.

Admin occupation set to 'Admin TEST'. Photo was uploaded then removed. No orphaned photos left on Victoria.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Directory feature verified end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_profile_directory.py is reusable for regression. Victoria and admin profile fields were mutated during testing; if a clean state is needed, reset via PATCH /api/auth/profile.
